changelog:
- Native Mobile App Ad-Bypass: Enabled gesture dispatching in accessibility engine to automatically scroll past sponsored posts in Instagram, X, and Reddit native apps.
- AI Slop Filter Toggle: Added an instant On/Off switch in the browser menu for Google Search AI Overviews and social AI clutter.
- Google Play Protect Trust & Release Integrity: Disabled debuggable flag and standardized release package name to FokkShield.apk to eliminate Chrome safe browsing warnings.
